scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: The discovery club wants a display that helps visitors find three activity tables. Kabir writes make everything as the first instruction. Meera asks what a visitor should be able to do, and which smaller jobs would make that result possible.
scenes.speech: The discovery club wants a display that helps visitors find three activity tables. Kabir writes make everything as the first instruction. Meera asks what a visitor should be able to do, and which smaller jobs would make that result possible.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: The club already has card, markers and a room map. These are inputs, not the finished goal. The desired output is a set of readable signs in the right places. Choosing locations, writing labels and checking readability are smaller tasks within the larger job.
scenes.speech: The club already has card, markers and a room map. These are inputs, not the finished goal. The desired output is a set of readable signs in the right places. Choosing locations, writing labels and checking readability are smaller tasks within the larger job.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: Decomposition means breaking a problem into manageable pieces. The team assigns each piece an observable result and tests the whole display with a fictional visitor route. A colourful sign is not enough if the visitor still cannot find the correct table without extra help.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose and explain
scenes.caption: The goal is helping a visitor find three tables, not simply using every marker or making the largest poster. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.speech: The goal is helping a visitor find three tables, not simply using every marker or making the largest poster. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: See the consequence
scenes.caption: List sign locations, readable labels and a visitor check as smaller jobs. Each piece supports the same observable goal and can be checked before the display opens.
scenes.speech: List sign locations, readable labels and a visitor check as smaller jobs. Each piece supports the same observable goal and can be checked before the display opens.
scenes.dialogue: Split a display task into workable pieces.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Your turn in the lab
scenes.caption: Now open the practice lab. Work through inputs and goals, then smaller tasks, then a success check. Test each answer, read feedback and try again when needed. Save your evidence and explain one decision in your own words.
